name: KNN from Scratch: classify Iris with 2 features
description: A k=5 majority vote, drawn as a scatter on the node

data.noteContent:
k-nearest neighbours has no training step: to label a flower, measure the distance to every flower already seen, take the five closest, and go with the majority. That is the whole model, and the node draws it -- 120 training points coloured by species, each of the 30 queries marked with a question mark.

29 of the 30 predictions match the held-out label. Iris ships with the repo, so nothing downloads and the run is instant.

The base install has the same idea built on the sklearn-backed KNN node; this one computes every distance itself.

k 最近鄰沒有訓練這個步驟：要判斷一朵花，就量它和看過的每一朵花的距離，取最近的五朵，再照多數決。這就是整個模型，而且節點會把它畫出來 -- 120 個訓練點依品種上色，30 個查詢點各標一個問號。

30 個預測裡有 29 個和保留的標籤相符。Iris 隨專案附上，不用下載，執行是瞬間的。

基本安裝裡有一個同樣題目、改用 sklearn 版 KNN 節點的範例；這一張則是自己把每個距離算出來。

Two of the four columns, petal length and petal width: the pair that separates the species best, and the two the card draws, since the scatter uses the first two features. Normalize puts both on one z-score scale so neither dominates the distance.

四欄裡挑兩欄：花瓣長度和花瓣寬度。這一組最能把品種分開，也正是卡片畫出來的那兩個 -- 散佈圖用的是前兩個特徵。接著 Normalize 把兩欄換算到同一個 z-score 尺度，距離才不會被其中一欄主導。

k is how many neighbours vote: 5 here, and the species with the most votes wins, with a tie going to the one whose neighbour is nearest. Drop it to 1 and each query copies its single closest neighbour, which follows the noise in the training points instead of the trend.

k 是幾個鄰居投票：這裡是 5，票數最多的品種勝出，平手時取鄰居離得比較近的那個品種。把它改成 1，每個查詢點就直接複製最近的那一個鄰居，跟著訓練點的雜訊走，而不是跟著趨勢。
